description: Election Commission - A. Iyyoobkhan was Selected as the member of the Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha - V. Kajeeban was Selected as the member of the Velannai Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Kuchchaveli and Velanai Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of new members to fill seats that became vacant due to resignation and party membership cessation. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically addressing candidate nominations and declarations for local government positions.
